name: Qin Shi Huang
role: King of Qin who conquered the Warring States and became China's first emperor
known_facts: Became King of Qin in 246 BC and conquered the six rival states
Unified China and declared himself First Emperor (Shi Huangdi) in 221 BC
Standardized script, currency, weights and measures, and road gauges
Ordered the linking of northern walls and a vast tomb with the Terracotta Army
interpretation: 3rd-century-BC Qin imperial / military dress, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
